article_title: Trial of German steakhouse heiress Christina Block that sparked a huge spy scandal

tasks.prompt: What two connected stories does the article explain?
options: A Hamburg child-abduction trial and a separate espionage investigation uncovered during related searches
The sale of a restaurant chain and a dispute over steak prices
A Danish election and a German intelligence reform
A television trial and the opening of a new security company
tasks.correct_answer: A Hamburg child-abduction trial and a separate espionage investigation uncovered during related searches
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מתארת את משפט החטיפה בהמבורג ואת חקירת הריגול הנפרדת שנולדה מראיות שנמצאו במהלך החקירה.

tasks.prompt: What do prosecutors allege Christina Block and Andreas Costard organised?
options: A legal appeal to change a Danish custody ruling
The forcible abduction of two children from their father's home in Denmark
The purchase of the Block House restaurant chain
A public investigation into Germany's intelligence service
tasks.correct_answer: The forcible abduction of two children from their father's home in Denmark
tasks.explanation_hebrew: התביעה טוענת שבלוק וקוסטארד ארגנו חטיפה בכוח של שני הילדים מבית אביהם בדנמרק; שניהם מכחישים עבירה.

tasks.prompt: What does “in the dock” mean when the article describes Christina Block?
options: Working at a Danish harbour
Waiting to board a ship
On trial as a defendant in court
Giving evidence as a police investigator
tasks.correct_answer: On trial as a defendant in court
tasks.explanation_hebrew: in the dock הוא ביטוי המתאר נאשם העומד למשפט בבית משפט.

options: Buying state documents from August Hanning
Taking part in the operation involving the children, while saying he believed it was a rescue
Writing the custody decision in Hamburg
Failing to appear as a witness in the trial
tasks.correct_answer: Taking part in the operation involving the children, while saying he believed it was a rescue
tasks.explanation_hebrew: יונתן ג׳ הודה במעורבות, אך אמר שסבר שהוא משתתף במבצע חילוץ.

tasks.prompt: Why is the article careful to distinguish August Hanning's espionage case from the Hamburg trial?
options: The alleged spying was discovered during the wider investigation but is not part of the current Block court case.
Hanning is one of the children involved in the custody dispute.
The Hamburg court has already convicted Hanning of the abduction.
The espionage charges concern the restaurant company's finances.
tasks.correct_answer: The alleged spying was discovered during the wider investigation but is not part of the current Block court case.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הראיות נגד האנינג נמצאו בחיפוש הקשור לחקירה, אך אישומי הריגול הם תיק נפרד והוא לא נאשם במשפט בלוק הנוכחי.

tasks.prompt: What does “acted on its own initiative” mean in Block's defence?
options: The security team followed a detailed court order.
The team decided and acted independently without her instruction.
The children travelled voluntarily on their own.
The Danish police organised the operation.
tasks.correct_answer: The team decided and acted independently without her instruction.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: on its own initiative פירושו שהצוות החליט ופעל בעצמו; זו טענת ההגנה של בלוק והיא שנויה במחלוקת במשפט.

tasks.prompt: What does the article say happened during the alleged New Year abduction operation?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לתאר בזהירות כטענת התביעה: מארב ותקיפת האב, הכנסת הילדים לרכב, החלפת כלי רכב, קשירה והעברה בקרוואן לגרמניה.
expected_points: Prosecutors say men ambushed and beat Stephan Hensel during a firework display.
The boy and girl, then aged 10 and 13, were dragged into a car.
The group allegedly changed vehicles near the German border and restrained the children.
They are said to have travelled in a campervan to Baden-Württemberg, where the children were held until 2 January 2024.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the custody dispute and the conflicting claims about responsibility for the operation.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את מגורי הילדים, החלטות בתי המשפט בגרמניה ובדנמרק, הכחשות בלוק והטענה שהצוות פעל לבד, מול עדות ברקאי שהתוכנית הייתה ידועה.
expected_points: After the parents separated, the children lived with Block and later visited their father in Denmark.
Two younger children were not returned in 2021; a Hamburg court ordered their return, while a Danish court later said they could not be sent back.
Block denies knowing about an abduction plan and says the Israeli team acted independently.
Security-team head David Barkay told the court that Block and Costard knew about the planned repatriation operation.

tasks.prompt: Why has the case attracted unusually intense public attention in Germany?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לקשור בין עושר ופרסום המשפחה, מאבק משמורת דרמטי, טענות לאלימות וחטיפה בינלאומית, קשרים לאנשי מודיעין, ופרשת הריגול הנפרדת.
expected_points: Block is the heir to a familiar and successful German restaurant chain.
The allegations involve a violent cross-border operation during a bitter family custody dispute.
Former German and Israeli intelligence figures are alleged to have links to parts of the story.
Evidence discovered in the investigation led to a separate treason and espionage case against a former intelligence chief.

tasks.prompt: Write a concise, legally careful report of the case that separates allegations, admissions and denials.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להשתמש במונחים כגון alleged, prosecutors say ו־denies; לציין את הודאת יונתן ג׳ והסתייגותו; ולהפריד בין תיק החטיפה לתיק הריגול של האנינג.
expected_points: Attribute the abduction account to prosecutors and avoid presenting disputed claims as proven facts.
State that Christina Block and the other defendants deny wrongdoing, except Jonathan G, who admits involvement but describes it as a rescue.
Mention Block's denial of prior knowledge and Barkay's conflicting testimony.
Explain that Hanning's espionage charges arose from evidence found during the investigation but are separate from the current Hamburg trial.
